articles.summary: Through a multi-year agreement with Qatar's Ministry of Communications and Information Technology (MCIT), Scale contributes alongside other partners to build that infrastructure. Across Scale's work with governments, AI is starting to take the same shape as other digital infrastructure: a shared layer designed for use across the public sector. Scale builds for that model, so components developed for one use case can carry over to the next as the architecture grows.
